description: Defines the ClusterMembershipOptions class which encapsulates configuration settings related to cluster membership management in Orleans, including timing, probing, and liveness parameters.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for cluster membership behavior, including liveness checks, timeouts, and cleanup policies.

methods.name: AllowedIAmAliveMissPeriod
methods.description: Calculates the period after which a silo is ignored for initial connectivity validation based on missed heartbeat counts.

methods.name: ClusteringShutdownGracePeriod
methods.description: Provides the duration to wait during shutdown for the cluster membership system to terminate gracefully.
